prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Finalize Your Desktop Pet's Official Adoption", "Name your companion and place the official adoption stamp to bring them to life.", "Pet Name"]
1: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is ready to live on your screen!", "Learn Quick Controls", "How to Interact with Your Pet", "Right-click to hide or open settings, drag to move across monitors, or click to interact.", "Quick Shortcuts & Gestures Guide"]
2: ["What Kind of Desktop Companion Do You Need?", "Select a personality style to tailor your setup experience.", "Calm & Focused vs Energetic & Playful"]
3: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in to complete registration and secure cloud sync for your customized pet.", "Sign In & Finish"]
4: ["Sign In to Access Your Desktop Pets", "Signing in automatically restores your existing pets, custom items, and account data across all your computers.", "Use the same email you previously registered to recover missing pets."]
5: ["For best rendering results, use clear, well-lit photos showing your pet's full face and body.", "Recommended: High resolution, bright lighting"]
6: ["Preparing Desktop Rendering", "We are setting up your companion to float over your desktop background.", "If your pet does not appear automatically, check app permissions in your system tray."]
7: ["Adopt Your Companion & Unlock a Free Starter Hat", "Complete setup today to receive an exclusive onboarding accessory pack.", "Includes Free Starter Accessory Pack"]
8: ["Your Pet is Active on Your Desktop!", "Click the taskbar / menu bar tray icon at any time to hide or wake your companion.", "Tip: Keep the system tray icon enabled so your pet is always one click away."]
9: ["Select How You Want to Build Your Companion", "Choose premade classic companions or upload photos for a custom pet."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and creates time-based urgency
